technical.summary: Mixed technicals with short-term bullish momentum (RSI-9, supertrend, three white soldiers) offset by intermediate bearish structure (below 50/200 MAs, ichimoku below cloud) and overbought conditions; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: QRVO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 28 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 18) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling by junior member and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 28 days present binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI-9 bullish, supertrend, three white soldiers) with price near support (84.83) offers contrarian entry in extreme fear environment with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, NFP/earnings binary events), price below all key moving averages, overbought oscillators, weak fundamentals, and no active strategy triggers create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, supertrend, three white soldiers) and contrarian fear opportunity present tactical appeal, but severe macro headwinds and weak fundamentals create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and binary earnings event in 28 days create compounding macro and event risk that can trigger sharp reversals despite near-term technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 43 positions in Information Technology sector; adding QRVO increases concentration risk in high-volatility tech during macro stress without offsetting conviction.
